limitations: FragmentRetentionChecks temporarily uses 0.7-second minimum and 0.1-second building lifetime, restores settings, and checks survival at 0.4 seconds and retirement by 0.95 seconds. Not a production-duration endurance test.
Siege budget uses controlled Tick times in a Play fixture. Real-frame physical falling is covered separately.
No claim of never disappearing, hard budget compliance during protection, exhaustive gameplay validation, Player build, or maximum-load performance acceptance.
